title: Atomic Habits
author: James Clear
tagline: Foydali odatni boshlashni, takrorlashni va motivatsiya so‘nganda ham davom ettirishni osonlashtiring.
intro: Nega ulkan rejalar ko‘pincha chorshanbagacha unutiladi-yu, besh daqiqalik kichik qadam esa ishlaydi? Bu darsda Jeyms Klirning maqsad va tizim, odatning to‘rt bosqichi va to‘rtta qonuni haqidagi g‘oyalarini talaba Aziz misolida ko‘rib chiqasiz.
learnPoints: Odatning to‘rt bosqichi: ishora, ishtiyoq, javob va mukofot
«Ikki daqiqa qoidasi» bilan yangi odatni qanday boshlash
Bir kunni o‘tkazib yuborsangiz nima qilish kerak
attribution: Independent Bookly summary and commentary on “Atomic Habits” by James Clear. Original examples by Bookly. AI-narrated. Not endorsed by the author or publisher. Muallif yoki nashriyot tomonidan tasdiqlanmagan mustaqil Bookly sharhi; kitobning tanlangan g‘oyalarini tanishtiradi va to‘liq kitob o‘rnini bosmaydi.

sentences.en: Imagine two versions of your evening.
sentences.uz: Oqshomingizning ikki xil ko‘rinishini tasavvur qiling.

sentences.en: In the first, you promise to study for two hours, get distracted, and go to bed disappointed.
sentences.uz: Birinchisida siz ikki soat o‘qishga va’da berasiz, chalg‘iysiz va hafsalangiz pir bo‘lib uxlashga yotasiz.

sentences.en: In the second, you open your notebook, solve one question, and stop after five minutes.
sentences.uz: Ikkinchisida daftaringizni ochasiz, bitta savolni yechasiz va besh daqiqadan keyin to‘xtaysiz.

sentences.en: Which evening looks more successful?
sentences.uz: Qaysi oqshom muvaffaqiyatliroq ko‘rinadi?

sentences.en: For building a habit, the second may be the more useful beginning.
sentences.uz: Odat shakllantirish uchun ikkinchisi foydaliroq boshlanish bo‘lishi mumkin.

sentences.en: You're listening to Bookly's summary of Atomic Habits by James Clear, a book about how repeated small actions can change the direction of your life.
sentences.uz: Siz Jeyms Klirning «Atomic Habits» («Atom odatlar») kitobi bo‘yicha Bookly qisqacha mazmunini tinglayapsiz — bu kitob takrorlanadigan kichik harakatlar hayotingiz yo‘nalishini qanday o‘zgartirishi haqida.

sentences.en: Clear distinguishes between goals and systems.
sentences.uz: Klir maqsadlar va tizimlarni bir-biridan ajratadi.

sentences.en: A goal describes the result you want, such as improving your English.
sentences.uz: Maqsad siz istagan natijani ifodalaydi, masalan, ingliz tilingizni yaxshilash.

sentences.en: A system is what you actually do: reviewing vocabulary after breakfast, practising a little each day, and returning to mistakes.
sentences.uz: Tizim esa amalda nima qilishingizdir: nonushtadan keyin so‘zlarni takrorlash, har kuni ozgina mashq qilish va xatolaringizga qaytish.

sentences.en: A goal can guide you, but the routine does the work.
sentences.uz: Maqsad yo‘l ko‘rsatishi mumkin, lekin ishni kundalik tartib bajaradi.

sentences.en: Consider a student we'll call Aziz.
sentences.uz: Keling, Aziz deb ataydigan bir talabani ko‘rib chiqaylik.

sentences.en: Every Sunday, Aziz creates an ambitious study timetable.
sentences.uz: Har yakshanba Aziz juda katta o‘qish jadvalini tuzadi.

sentences.en: By Wednesday, he's abandoned it.
sentences.uz: Chorshanbaga kelib esa undan voz kechib bo‘ladi.

sentences.en: He keeps changing the timetable, but his evenings still begin with a laptop full of distracting tabs and no clear first task.
sentences.uz: U jadvalni qayta-qayta o‘zgartiradi, ammo oqshomlari hamon chalg‘ituvchi oynalarga to‘la noutbuk bilan va aniq birinchi vazifasiz boshlanadi.

sentences.en: A practical application of Clear's approach would be to change that starting situation.
sentences.uz: Klir yondashuvini amalda qo‘llash — aynan shu boshlang‘ich vaziyatni o‘zgartirish bo‘lardi.

sentences.en: Before dinner, Aziz leaves one practice question open on his desk.
sentences.uz: Kechki ovqatdan oldin Aziz stolida bitta mashq savolini ochiq qoldiradi.

sentences.en: His next step becomes visible and specific.
sentences.uz: Uning keyingi qadami ko‘rinadigan va aniq bo‘lib qoladi.

sentences.en: He doesn't have to decide where to begin while already feeling tired.
sentences.uz: Endi u charchagan holatda nimadan boshlashni o‘ylab o‘tirishi shart emas.

sentences.en: Clear organizes habit formation into four stages: cue, craving, response, and reward.
sentences.uz: Klir odat shakllanishini to‘rt bosqichga ajratadi: ishora, ishtiyoq, javob harakati va mukofot.

sentences.en: Something catches your attention, you anticipate a benefit, you act, and you experience an outcome.
sentences.uz: Nimadir e’tiboringizni tortadi, siz foyda kutasiz, harakat qilasiz va natijani his qilasiz.

sentences.en: His four laws help you design that cycle.
sentences.uz: Uning to‘rtta qonuni shu aylanishni o‘zingizga moslab qurishga yordam beradi.

sentences.en: First, make the cue obvious.
sentences.uz: Birinchidan, ishorani ko‘zga tashlanadigan qiling.

sentences.en: Connect a new action to something you already do.
sentences.uz: Yangi harakatni allaqachon qilib yurgan ishingizga bog‘lang.

sentences.en: After putting away your dinner plate, sit down and read one page.
sentences.uz: Kechki ovqat likopchangizni yig‘ishtirgach, o‘tirib bir bet o‘qing.

sentences.en: An existing routine becomes a reminder, which is more dependable than hoping you'll remember later.
sentences.uz: Mavjud odatingiz eslatmaga aylanadi — bu «keyin esimga tushar» deb umid qilishdan ancha ishonchliroq.

sentences.en: Second, make the activity attractive.
sentences.uz: Ikkinchidan, mashg‘ulotni jozibali qiling.

sentences.en: Pair a useful task with something you enjoy, or join people who already practise it.
sentences.uz: Foydali ishni o‘zingiz yoqtirgan narsa bilan juftlang yoki uni allaqachon mashq qilayotgan odamlarga qo‘shiling.

sentences.en: Aziz might review vocabulary with a friend who makes the session enjoyable.
sentences.uz: Aziz so‘zlarni mashg‘ulotni qiziqarli qiladigan do‘sti bilan birga takrorlashi mumkin.

sentences.en: The point is to give the habit something to look forward to.
sentences.uz: Maqsad — odatda intiqlik bilan kutadigan nimadir bo‘lishi.

sentences.en: Third, make it easy.
sentences.uz: Uchinchidan, uni oson qiling.

sentences.en: Clear's two-minute rule suggests shrinking a new habit to an opening action that takes less than two minutes.
sentences.uz: Klirning «ikki daqiqa qoidasi» yangi odatni ikki daqiqadan kam vaqt oladigan boshlang‘ich harakatgacha qisqartirishni taklif qiladi.

sentences.en: For Aziz, that could mean sitting down and attempting the first line of a problem.
sentences.uz: Aziz uchun bu stolga o‘tirib, masalaning birinchi qatorini yechishga urinish bo‘lishi mumkin.

sentences.en: The small beginning establishes a routine that can grow into substantial practice.
sentences.uz: Kichik boshlanish keyinchalik jiddiy mashg‘ulotga aylanishi mumkin bo‘lgan tartibni yo‘lga qo‘yadi.

sentences.en: Fourth, make the result satisfying.
sentences.uz: To‘rtinchidan, natijani qoniqarli qiling.

sentences.en: A simple mark on a calendar can make completion visible.
sentences.uz: Taqvimdagi oddiy belgi bajarilgan ishni ko‘rinadigan qiladi.

sentences.en: But the mark should represent the behaviour you care about.
sentences.uz: Ammo bu belgi siz uchun muhim bo‘lgan xatti-harakatni anglatishi kerak.

sentences.en: Ticking a box after opening a textbook means little if you never engage with it.
sentences.uz: Agar darslik bilan haqiqatan shug‘ullanmasangiz, uni ochganingiz uchun belgi qo‘yishning ma’nosi kam.

sentences.en: Track an honest, useful action.
sentences.uz: Halol va foydali harakatni qayd eting.

sentences.en: You can also reverse these ideas to interrupt unwanted habits.
sentences.uz: Bu g‘oyalarni teskari qo‘llab, keraksiz odatlarni to‘xtatishingiz ham mumkin.

sentences.en: Hide distracting cues and add friction before the behaviour.
sentences.uz: Chalg‘ituvchi ishoralarni yashiring va bu xatti-harakat oldiga to‘siq qo‘ying.

sentences.en: If Aziz keeps opening entertainment websites, logging out and closing those tabs before studying creates a small barrier.
sentences.uz: Agar Aziz ko‘ngilochar saytlarni qayta-qayta ochaversa, o‘qishdan oldin akkauntdan chiqish va o‘sha oynalarni yopish kichik to‘siq bo‘ladi.

sentences.en: Meanwhile, his practice question is already waiting.
sentences.uz: Bu orada uning mashq savoli allaqachon kutib turibdi.

heading.uz: O‘zlik, sabr va o‘tkazib yuborilgan kunlar

sentences.en: Another important idea is identity.
sentences.uz: Yana bir muhim g‘oya — o‘zlik, ya’ni o‘zingizni kim deb bilishingiz.

sentences.en: When you repeatedly keep a small commitment, you collect evidence about the kind of person you are becoming.
sentences.uz: Kichik va’dangizni qayta-qayta bajarganingizda, qanday insonga aylanayotganingiz haqida dalil to‘playsiz.

sentences.en: Aziz doesn't need to declare himself perfectly disciplined.
sentences.uz: Aziz o‘zini mukammal intizomli deb e’lon qilishi shart emas.

sentences.en: Each completed session gives him a concrete reason to trust that he can return to learning.
sentences.uz: Har bir yakunlangan mashg‘ulot unga o‘qishga qayta olishiga ishonish uchun aniq asos beradi.

sentences.en: Small actions also need time.
sentences.uz: Kichik harakatlarga vaqt ham kerak.

sentences.en: A few evenings of revision may produce no obvious change in an exam score.
sentences.uz: Bir necha oqshomlik takrorlash imtihon balida sezilarli o‘zgarish bermasligi mumkin.

sentences.en: That doesn't automatically mean the effort is wasted.
sentences.uz: Bu harakat albatta behuda ketdi degani emas.

sentences.en: Look at whether your process is improving, while checking that the practice itself is useful.
sentences.uz: Jarayoningiz yaxshilanayotganiga qarang va shu bilan birga mashqning o‘zi foydali ekanini tekshiring.

sentences.en: Repeating an ineffective method still needs correction.
sentences.uz: Samarasiz usulni takrorlayverish baribir tuzatishni talab qiladi.

sentences.en: And when you miss a day, resume at the next reasonable opportunity.
sentences.uz: Bir kunni o‘tkazib yuborsangiz, keyingi qulay imkoniyatda davom eting.

sentences.en: Let the missed session tell you something about the routine.
sentences.uz: O‘tkazib yuborilgan mashg‘ulot sizga tartibingiz haqida nimanidir aytsin.

sentences.en: Perhaps the time was unrealistic, or the task was too large.
sentences.uz: Balki vaqt noreal bo‘lgandir yoki vazifa juda katta bo‘lgandir.

sentences.en: Adjust it rather than treating one interruption as your identity.
sentences.uz: Bitta uzilishni o‘zligingiz deb bilish o‘rniga, tartibni moslashtiring.

sentences.en: Here's your Bookly challenge.
sentences.uz: Mana sizning Bookly topshirig‘ingiz.

sentences.en: Choose one behaviour you want to repeat tomorrow.
sentences.uz: Ertaga takrorlamoqchi bo‘lgan bitta xatti-harakatni tanlang.

sentences.en: Attach it to an existing routine, reduce its starting step to under two minutes, and prepare the materials tonight.
sentences.uz: Uni mavjud odatingizga bog‘lang, boshlang‘ich qadamini ikki daqiqadan kamga qisqartiring va kerakli narsalarni bugun kechqurun tayyorlab qo‘ying.

sentences.en: Then try it.
sentences.uz: Keyin sinab ko‘ring.

sentences.en: A useful habit begins with an action you can actually take again.
sentences.uz: Foydali odat haqiqatan ham qayta bajara oladigan harakatdan boshlanadi.

vocab.definition: something you do regularly, often without thinking
vocab.example: Reading one page before bed is a small habit.
vocab.exampleUz: Uxlashdan oldin bir bet o‘qish — kichik odat.

vocab.definition: the usual order in which you do things
vocab.example: My morning routine starts with a glass of water.
vocab.exampleUz: Ertalabki tartibim bir stakan suvdan boshlanadi.

vocab.definition: a signal that tells you to do something
vocab.example: Seeing my running shoes is a cue to go for a walk.
vocab.exampleUz: Krossovkalarimni ko‘rish menga sayrga chiqish uchun ishora bo‘ladi.

vocab.definition: something good you get after an action
vocab.example: A short break is my reward after studying.

vocab.definition: unable to focus because something else takes your attention
vocab.example: I get distracted when my phone is on the desk.

vocab.definition: something that makes an action a little harder to do
vocab.example: Logging out adds friction to scrolling.
vocab.exampleUz: Akkauntdan chiqish lenta varaqlashga to‘siq qo‘shadi.

vocab.example: Each small win shapes your identity as a learner.
vocab.exampleUz: Har bir kichik yutuq o‘quvchi sifatidagi o‘zligingizni shakllantiradi.

vocab.example: Keep a small commitment every day.

questions.prompt: What is the difference between a goal and a system?
questions.promptUz: Maqsad va tizim o‘rtasidagi farq nima?
options: A goal is the result you want; a system is what you actually do
A goal is daily practice; a system is your exam score
They mean exactly the same thing
optionsUz: Maqsad — istagan natijangiz; tizim — amalda nima qilishingiz
Maqsad — kundalik mashq; tizim — imtihon balingiz
Ular aynan bir xil ma’noni anglatadi
questions.explanationUz: Klirga ko‘ra, maqsad yo‘l ko‘rsatadi, lekin ishni kundalik tartib — tizim bajaradi.

questions.prompt: What does the two-minute rule suggest?
options: Study for at least two hours every day
Shrink a new habit to an opening action that takes less than two minutes
Stop every task after two minutes
optionsUz: Har kuni kamida ikki soat o‘qish
Yangi odatni ikki daqiqadan kam vaqt oladigan boshlang‘ich harakatgacha qisqartirish
Har qanday ishni ikki daqiqadan keyin to‘xtatish
questions.explanationUz: Kichik boshlanish — masalan, masalaning birinchi qatori — keyinchalik jiddiy mashg‘ulotga aylanadigan tartibni yo‘lga qo‘yadi.

questions.prompt: What should you do when you miss a day?
questions.promptUz: Bir kunni o‘tkazib yuborsangiz nima qilish kerak?
options: Give up, because the habit is broken
Make a much bigger plan for next week
Resume at the next reasonable opportunity and adjust the routine
optionsUz: Keyingi hafta uchun ancha katta reja tuzish
Keyingi qulay imkoniyatda davom etish va tartibni moslashtirish
questions.explanationUz: O‘tkazib yuborilgan kun tartibingiz haqida nimanidir aytadi: vaqt yoki vazifani moslashtiring va davom eting.

takeaway.en: Attach one behaviour to an existing routine, shrink its first step to under two minutes, and prepare the materials tonight.
takeaway.uz: Bitta xatti-harakatni mavjud odatingizga bog‘lang, birinchi qadamini ikki daqiqadan kamga qisqartiring va kerakli narsalarni bugun kechqurun tayyorlab qo‘ying.
